textwithimage.text:
Embedded Cortex®-A53 / R5F module based on TI AM64xx for headless Applications with Real-time demand

The embedded module TQMa64xxL, is based on the processor family AM64xx (up to Dual Cortex A53 / up to Quad Cortex R5F) from Texas Instruments. This LGA (Land Grid Array) module is designed to use the pin compatible processors on one module design. This module is ideally suited for headless applications with extended real-time requirements. The CPU offers with their integrated PRU (Programmable Realtime Unit) up to 4x Gigabit Ethernet interfaces with TSN support for the realization of real-time applications. In addition, they have various interfaces such as USB2.0, CAN-FD, UART, SerDes, etc.

text.text:
Features

  • 4x Real-time GBit Ethernet for Fieldbus
  • Up to 2 x CAN - FD
  • Integrated Cortex M4
  • High-speed communication via 2x GBit Ethernet, 1x USB 2.0 interface, 1x SerDes (PCIe/USB 3.0)
  • Low power consumption (typ. 1-2W)
  • Integrated security functions

table.text:
CPU

CPU/Processor:

  • Cortex®-A53 - Up to 1GHz
  • Cortex®-R5F - Up to 800MHz
  • Dual Cortex®-A53 - Up to 1GHz

CPU variant:

  • AM6442 Dual A53 + 2x Dual R5F
  • AM6441 Single A53 + 2x Dual R5F
  • AM6421 Single A53 + Dual R5F
  • AM6412 Dual A53 + Single R5F
  • AM6411 Single A53 + Single R5F
Memory

LPDDR4:

  • Up to 2 GB

NOR Flash:

  • Up to 256 MB

eMMC:

  • Up to 64 GB

EEPROM:

  • 0/64-kbit
Communication interfaces

Ethernet:

  • Up to 2x Gbit-Ethernet
  • Up to 4x Real- time Gbit Ethernet (PRU)

USB:

  • Up to 1x USB 2.0 interface
  • Up to 1x USB 3.0 (shared with PCIe)

CAN:

  • Up to 2x CAN FD

Serial Ports:

  • Up to 9x UART
Other interfaces

SD Card:

  • Up to 2x SDIO

I2C:

  • Up to 6x I2C

SPI:

  • Up to 7x MCSPI
  • Up to 1x OSPI or QSPI

ADC:

  • Up to 1x ADC

PCIe:

  • Up to 1x PCIe (shared with USB 3.0)
General

Power supply:

  • 5 V

Temperature range:

  • Standard temperature range: -25°C - +85°C
  • Extended temperature: -40°C - +85°C

Dimensions:

  • 38 x 38 mm

Plug-in System:

  • LGA (Land Grid Array) 240 pins (TBD)
OS

OS Support:

  • Real-time Operating System (TBD)
  • Linux (Cortex A53)
